name: Purelight
author: MarshalX
description: Every effect in front of you that can actually be removed, worst first: on you, your pet, your group and your target, each tile naming who carries it.

preview.alt: a strip of five square tiles, each a countdown over the art with the name of whoever carries the effect under it. The borders colour by school, and one tile has no art at all.
